§5- Forged from the origin of light and darkness in several realities,
the Equinox Slicer is a weapon of unparalleled power—yet merely a prototype of something far greater.
This scythe bends the fabric of existence itself, capable of rending reality as if it were mere parchment.
A fusion of countless realms, it pulses with an unstable,
destructive energy—each strike threatening to unravel the boundaries between worlds.
Though its design remains incomplete, its wrath is undeniable, and in the right hands,
even in its unfinished state, nothing can stand in its way.
(Originating from Craftwars Overhaul)
